headlines.title: ‘ 1대지 1허가 ’ 깨고 로봇 펜스 치운다…규제 풀어 4.2조 투자 마중물
headlines.summary: 용인 반도체 클러스터 2.5조 조기 집행 예상 인구절벽·혁신 저하 속 선순환 물꼬 정부가 '1대지 1허가' 원칙을 깨고 산업현장의 '1.8m 로봇 안전 펜스' 의무를 철폐하는 등 규제 혁신에 나선다. 인허가 체증과 낡은 법령에 막혀 있던 현장대기 프로젝트 5건의 빗장을 풀어 총 4조2000억원 규모의 민간 투자를 이끌어낸다는 구상이다.

headlines.title: 산단 증설때 별도허가제 … ‘ 용인 반도체 7년 단축 ’ 속도전
headlines.summary: 정부, 건축법 규제 완화 조치 2조 규모 조기투자 가능해져 정부가 용인 반도체 클러스터 ‘7년 단축’ 목표에 맞춰 공장 증설 때마다 건축허가를 변경해야 했던 건축법 규제를 완화키로 했다. 메모리 반도체 품귀 지속에 전 세계 기업들의 메모리 증산 경쟁이 본격화하면서 공장 증설을 조기 이행토록 해 경쟁우위 확보를 지원하려는 것이다.

headlines.title: 용인 반도체공장 증설때 ‘ 별도 허가 ’ 해준다
headlines.summary: 정부, 현장중심 기업투자·혁신지원방안 규제·인허가에 막힌 4.3조 투자 속도 증설 때마다 허가변경서 ‘별도 허가’ 하이닉스 트리니티팹, 증여세 비과세 구미·포항산단 입주 업종에 리사이클링 정부가 규제와 인허가에 막혀 있던 약 4조3000억원 규모의 기업 투자에 속도를 낸다.

headlines.summary: 중기부 '제2차 모두의 창업 프로젝트 추진계획' 일반·기술 분야 8천명·로컬 분야 2천명 등 1만명 선발 2차 모두의 창업 프로젝트 추진계획. 중기부 제공 [파이낸셜뉴스] 국민 누구나 창업에 도전하는 것을 목표로 하는 '모두의 창업' 프로젝트 규모가 두 배로 확대된다.

headlines.title: 정부, ‘ 고수온 피해 ’ 어가에 332억 재난지원금

headlines.title: 서울 준공업지역 2만7천가구 공급 속도…도심복합 2만가구+α도 검토

headlines.title: 청년이 2.5억 빌라 살 때 연 3%대·2억 빌려준다 [8·13 공급대책]

headlines.title: 韓 조선, 7월 선박 수주 점유율 16% … 中 81 %
headlines.summary: 글로벌 발주량 전월比 56% 감소 1~7월 韓 누적 수주 61% 증가 中 수주잔량 66% 차지…韓 18% 지난달 전 세계 선박 발주량이 전월 대비 절반 이상 감소한 가운데 한국 조선업계의 수주 점유율은 16%에 그쳤다. 중국은 전체 발주량의 81%를 가져가며 한국과의 격차를 벌렸다. 다만 올해 1~7월 한국의 누적 수주량은 전년 동기 대비 61% 증가했다.

headlines.title: 국내복귀·외투기업 지방투자 지원 강화
headlines.summary: 유턴법 시행령 이르면 10월 시행 대규모·전략투자 ‘협상’ 방식 도입 정부가 국내복귀(유턴) 기업과 외국인투자기업의 지방 투자 촉진에 나선다. 지난달 입법예고한 ‘유턴법(국내복귀지원법)’ 시행령 개정안을 이르면 올해 10월 시행하고, 내년부터 보조금 지원체계도 전면 개편한다.

key_headlines.title: Government Bans Jeonse Loans for Non-Resident Single-Home Owners in Seoul Metropolitan Area
key_headlines.summary: Starting next year, single-home owners holding apartments over 300 million won in the Seoul metropolitan area without residence history will be prohibited from obtaining jeonse loans, with guarantee ratios reduced by 10 percentage points to 70-80%.

key_headlines.title: Government Announces Third Housing Supply Plan with 230,000+ Units
key_headlines.summary: The government unveiled comprehensive housing measures including relaxation of non-apartment regulations, introduction of safety trusts, and expedited redevelopment projects to address housing shortages and affordability concerns.

key_headlines.title: Youth Housing Support Package: Up to 80% LTV Loans for Non-Apartment Properties Under 400 Million Won
key_headlines.summary: Young people earning under 70 million won annually can now obtain loans covering up to 80% of property value for first-time purchases of villas and officetel units under 400 million won starting next year.

key_headlines.title: Government Relaxes Building Code Regulations to Accelerate Yongin Semiconductor Cluster by 7 Years
key_headlines.summary: By removing factory expansion permit requirements for semiconductor manufacturing, the government aims to enable early investment of 2 trillion won and secure competitive advantage amid global memory semiconductor shortage.

key_headlines.title: First-Half Fiscal Deficit Reaches 84.4 Trillion Won, Lowest in 3 Years
key_headlines.summary: Government revenue increased 61.3 trillion won year-over-year with income and corporate taxes up 10.4 trillion and 4.3 trillion won respectively, resulting in the smallest fiscal deficit in three years.

sections.Hot Economy News: The government released its third comprehensive housing supply plan on August 13, addressing affordability and supply challenges through multiple mechanisms. Key measures include prohibiting jeonse loans for non-resident single-home owners, introducing safety trusts, and easing regulations on non-apartment housing. Additionally, the government announced youth-targeted housing support with up to 80% LTV loans for properties under 400 million won, and accelerating redevelopment projects to increase housing stock by over 230,000 units.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's first-half fiscal deficit totaled 84.4 trillion won, marking the lowest level in three years despite increased government spending. Government revenue surged 61.3 trillion won year-over-year, with income taxes rising 10.4 trillion won from performance bonuses and increased real estate transactions, and corporate taxes up 4.3 trillion won. The Bank of Korea's student mock monetary policy committee favored rate hikes in August, suggesting a possible consecutive rate increase. U.S. inflation eased to 3.4% in July, reducing pressure for Federal Reserve rate hikes, with markets now pricing in a 60% probability of rate maintenance in September.
sections.Financial Markets: Kospi maintained a 3-4% surge with four consecutive days of gains, while Kosdaq showed 0.29% growth reaching 861.37 points. Strong semiconductor sector performance and weakened U.S. rate hike expectations drove the rally, with the won-dollar exchange rate moving to 1,419.4 won. CME FedWatch data indicates a 60% probability of Fed rate maintenance in September. Convertible bond issuances increased as equity market optimism grows, with Kospi rising over 50% since year-start to the 6,500 level.
sections.Industry & Technology: LG Energy Solution and General Motors' battery joint venture restarted operations in Ohio after a seven-month hiatus, responding to renewed electric vehicle demand. The government announced regulatory relief for semiconductor, secondary battery, and biotech sectors, projecting 4.2 trillion won in induced investment. Hyundai Motor and Samsung Electronics expanded cooperation across semiconductors, automotive electronics, and software-defined vehicles. Korea Zinc began supplying copper foil, a critical battery material, to global battery manufacturers, strengthening South Korea's position in EV supply chains.
sections.Real Estate: The government introduced comprehensive real estate financing measures including lower deposit requirements for redevelopment/reconstruction projects and increased relocation loan limits based on post-completion property values. Redevelopment union formation consent rates were lowered from 75% to 70%, accelerating project timelines. New public housing programs target low-income households and young people, with options to accumulate ownership stakes over time. Non-apartment housing supply faces deregulation to expand options beyond apartments and reduce housing costs for lower-income families.
sections.International Economy: U.S. auto dealer associations publicly urged the Trump administration to block Chinese vehicles from entering the American market, citing existing 127.5% tariffs and concerns following Chinese EV penetration of European markets. U.S. inflation moderated to 3.4% in July, reducing Federal Reserve rate hike justification and shifting market expectations toward rate maintenance. China redirected rare earth exports away from the U.S. and Japan toward Netherlands, adapting to targeted export controls. Competition intensified between the U.S. and China over advanced AI technology, with the U.S. scrutinizing Chinese AI firm acquisitions.
sections.AI & Economy: Samsung SDS and Naver lead in government AI system construction projects, with multiple ministries confirming adoption and sequential service launches by month-end. Naver expanded AI infrastructure investments into renewable energy by investing in Panthalassa, a U.S. startup developing wave-powered floating data centers. Survey results show 91.5% of major Korean manufacturers recognize AI transformation necessity across supply chains, though partner firm capability gaps present implementation constraints. Global AI infrastructure demand surged with CoreWeave reporting 25 billion dollars in Q3 contracts, exceeding annual totals, while Chinese AI companies benefit from patient capital and domestic chip development avoiding U.S. sanctions.
sections.Others: Caroline Leavitt, the youngest White House press secretary and key Trump administration official, announced resignation at month-end to spend time with family amid midterm election pressures. Indian gig work platforms now provide physical AI training data as a new export resource, expanding beyond traditional software services, call centers, and SaaS industries. Korean beauty company Able C&C achieved 53% operating profit growth in Q2 with overseas revenue reaching 69.80% of cosmetics sales, having expanded to 56 countries. The U.S. and Japan jointly pursue deep-sea rare earth mining at 6,000 meters depth, seeking to break China's supply chain dominance after export control retaliation.
